public_rationale: The chemistry award recognized AlphaFold2, but that does not settle its classification as neurosymbolic AI. The original paper documents both an end-to-end neural approach and substantial domain structure and supporting algorithms. Calling those components symbolic AI requires a definition the post does not make precise. The earlier Nobel record must then be assessed under the same definition. Neither support nor contradiction is established.
limitations: End-to-end learning and neurosymbolic design are not necessarily mutually exclusive.
A terminology dispute should not be converted into a categorical technical verdict.
The historical search did not establish an exhaustive absence of earlier qualifying awards.

criteria.contradiction_condition: An earlier Nobel recognized a qualifying neurosymbolic system, or the recognized AlphaFold system does not meet that definition.
